abstract: Dysgerminomas of the ovary are rare germ cell tumors. They are more common at puberty. Surgery followed by irradiation has resulted in excellent cure rates in early stages of this disease. This paper is a review of six patients with a diagnosis of dysgerminoma who were treated at the Department of Radiation Oncology, University of Louisville. The controversy on the use of irradiation in Stage Ia tumor is discussed in detail. A review of the literature is also done in this paper.
abstract_ja: 卵巣のディスジャーミノーマは稀な胚細胞腫瘍であり、思春期に多くみられる。手術に続く放射線療法により、早期病変では優れた治癒率が得られている。本稿では、ルイビル大学放射線腫瘍科で治療された6例を報告し、病期Iaに対する放射線療法の是非について詳細に論じる。また文献レビューも行う。
